description: This file defines API routes for managing 'trips' in a travel planning backend using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It includes functions to list, create, retrieve, update, and delete trip records, along with some internal logic to seed demo trips.

methods.name: None _ensure_demo_trip(db: AsyncSession, user: User)
methods.description: Internal function to seed a demo trip for the first user if none exist.

methods.name: list[TripOut] list_trips( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list trips belonging to the current user.

methods.name: TripOut create_trip( payload: TripCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new trip for the current user.

methods.name: TripOut get_trip( trip_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific trip by ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: TripOut update_trip( trip_id: int, payload: TripUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to update details of an existing trip, with validation on dates.

methods.name: DeleteResponse delete_trip( trip_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a specific trip and associated resources.
